map_fix.adaptation: Suspend RenderUtils buffer flushing only around map alpha-state capture/disable/restore; restore the previous flush flag in finally. No shaderpack equations or map textures changed.
map_fix.vanilla: Original custom core shader remains for 16/255 and 24/255 unexplored pixels.
